short: Suitable prime pairs on every large window

statements.markdown: Statement 9.2 (PairEx). For every modulus M 0 , every 0 < ε < 52 and every A ≥ 1, for all large Y there are primes q and d of the sizes above, prime to M 0 , such that for every character ξ modulo M 0 and every (i, j) ̸ = (0, 0) the twist χ of ξ satisfies |G χ (y)| ≤ y 1/2+ε/2 and L ′ (1, χ) ≤ 4 log y L for all Y ≤ y ≤ Y A , and such that the twists of the real characters of modulus dividing 8M 0 have no zero with 1 Re s > 1 − 400 up to a stated height.

lean.name: UpperTheory.Top.PairEx
lean.plain: Suitable prime pairs on every large window
lean.fidelity_note: Lean proves the same two numerical bounds on $[Y,Y^A]$ for the primitive character agreeing with the twist on integers coprime to $2M_0qd$. The paper writes the bounds for the twist itself and leaves the zero-free height implicit. Lean uses $8M_0\exp(Y^{\varepsilon/5})\exp(jY^{\varepsilon/5}(\log Y)^2)$, with $j$ indicating the presence of the $d$-twist.
